item.title: Functional programming with match
item.description:
Python 3.9 became EOL last week, which means you now have no reason to not write match statements anymore. While python’s match pattern matching isn’t as sophisticated or flexible as Elixir’s or Haskell’s, it’s still a massive improvement over other mainstream languages.

Recap

This is a recap if you’re not a pythonista; unpacking has existed since the early days. You’ve probably already done things like this

a, b = (1, 2)
print(a + b)

That’s great, and you’ve probably already tried iterable unpacking (PEP 3132)
